title: NieR: Automata patch makes Steam install 366GB 💾
subject: nierautomata
description:
Did this update hit your SSD? 👇

A NieR: Automata Steam update released November 6, 2026 added Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, but pushed the download size from under 50GB to 366GB. Square Enix says it is investigating the cause. Unchecking the DLC in Steam's Properties lets the base game download at its normal size.

Sources: Square Enix Steam post via PC Gamer (Nov 7, 2026), Kotaku (Nov 6, 2026), VGC
Game footage © Square Enix.

scenes.text: A NieR: Automata patch made the game 366GB on Steam.
The November 6 update only added Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
scenes.search: computer hard drive storage full warning

scenes.text: Before that, the full install sat under 50GB.
Square Enix posted on Steam that it's investigating the cause, and apologized for the inconvenience.
scenes.search: pc gaming setup dark room monitor

scenes.text: PC Gamer reports the bug seems tied to the eight DLC packs, each showing the full game's size.
Until a fix arrives, untick the DLC in Steam's Properties menu and the base game downloads normally.
